item.description: This option will cover the player UI on the main video. This image can either be uploaded in each video setting or auto-generated by Divi.
item.label: Show Image Overlays on Main Video

item.description: Pick a color to use for the overlay that appears behind the play icon when hovering over the video.
item.label: Thumbnail Overlay Color

item.description: Here you can choose whether your color should be light or dark. If you are working with a dark background, then your controls color should be light. If your background is light, then your controls color should be set to dark.
item.label: Slider Controls Color

item.description: This setting will turn on and off the navigation arrows.
item.label: Show Arrows

item.description: This setting will let you choose to use the thumbnail track controls below the slider or dot navigation at the bottom of the slider.
item.label: Slider Controls

module.description: Carousel of multiple videos that visitors can step through one at a time.
module.name: divi/video-slider
module.title: Video Slider
